app.alerts: Tap “Start receiving orders” in Milestone M3 to unlock loud alerts.

setup.title: Store setup
setup.name: Business name
setup.pickupPh: e.g. Side door, call on arrival
setup.pinHint: Tap the map or drag the pin, then confirm. Search by name, or type exact lat/lng.

agree.title: Partner Agreement
agree.tick: I agree to the Partner Agreement, including the staff-fallback clause.
agree.sub: A fair partnership, in plain words.
agree.submitted: Already submitted by {{name}} on {{date}} — waiting for approval.
agree.submittedApproved: Submitted by {{name}} on {{date}} — approved. Welcome aboard!
agree.submittedRejected: Submitted by {{name}} on {{date}} — not approved. Check your email for the reason; update your store profile and sign again.
agree.updated: Status update: {{s}}. The review team also emailed you.
agree.done: Signed ✓ Status is now pending approval.

staff.title: Staff
staff.howJoinBody: They sign up in the Stride & Earn app with the same email you invited, open Staff mode, pick this store, and clock on shift. Invites are by email — there is no code.

status.title: Store status
status.pending: Pending approval — we will email you. Menu (M2) and live orders (M3) come next.

menu.title: Menu
menu.sub: What runners carry. Only “travels well” dishes can be delivered.
menu.pauseNote: Paused on this device only — the API has no pause field yet; M3 will enforce it.
menu.name: Name
menu.photoHint: or tap to browse · JPG/PNG, max 5 MB
menu.options: Options (priced add-ons, kept on this device)
menu.needName: Type the dish name in at least one language.
menu.empty: No dishes yet — snap a menu photo or add one by hand.
menu.emptySub: Snap-a-Menu drafts every price as empty: you type them.

import.title: Snap-a-Menu
import.sub: One photo becomes draft dishes. You type every price — AI never sets one.
import.dropHint: or tap to browse · JPG/PNG/WebP · shrunk to 1600 px
import.shrink: Shrunk to 1600 px before upload to save bandwidth.
import.checked: I checked all prices by hand — they match the printed menu.
import.tickFirst: Tick the box above to publish: every price must be typed by you.
import.needPrices: Every row needs a typed price before publishing.

orders.title: Live orders
orders.sub: Big buttons, loud alarm. Keep the screen on.
orders.pushOff: push off — listen for the alarm
orders.showCode: Show this code to the runner or biker — never ask them for the customer PIN.
orders.courierStaff: Staff fallback running — a teammate may still accept
orders.empty: No orders yet — start receiving and listen for the bell.
orders.emptySub: The alarm fires on every new order.
orders.cancelRefundNote: The customer is refunded in full and the courier is told not to pick up.
orders.courierFoundKitchen: Courier found — check the order card for their name.
orders.pickupCodeNote: Merchant code only — show it to the courier. The customer has a separate delivery PIN you never see.
orders.pickupStep: Step 1 of 2 · Show this code to your courier at the counter — they type it to pick up. Step 2 (the customer's own PIN at their door) is between courier and customer only; you never need it.

earn.title: Earnings
earn.sub: What the kitchen kept. Payouts are mocked in demo.
earn.mockNote: Demo payouts are mocked — no real money moves.
